name: LustContract
source:
Did you have a desire to be a boss? Yes?! Great, let's make a deal!

In this game you will have to assume the role of the new head of a small cafe.
You have three young girls under your command: two lovely waitresses and a strict bartender. The girls are different both in appearance and in their characters, but they have one thing in common: they don't like you!

So you, as the new director of the cafe, will have to solve issues not only related to work, but also try to please your assistants, because the future of the cafe depends on how you build your relationship with them.

Luckily for you (or not) a sexy succubus has proposed to assist you. Who is this? Just a demon from hell, so don't worry too much. She's nice. The demon will aid you in making friends with the girls and, most importantly, in seducing them! Why does she need this? Let's just say - she feeds on sexual energy, and she is very hungry!

Make sure to keep the contract and don't disappoint her. It's not a good idea to end up in Hell, where she'll be in charge.
translation:
你有当老板的愿望吗？是的？！太好了，我们来做个交易吧！

在这个游戏中，你将扮演一家小咖啡馆的新老板的角色。
你手下有三个年轻女孩：两个可爱的女服务员和一个严格的调酒师。女孩们无论是外表还是性格都各不相同，但她们有一个共同点：她们不喜欢你！

所以，作为咖啡馆的新任主管，你不仅要解决工作方面的问题，还要努力取悦你的助手，因为咖啡馆的未来取决于你如何与他们建立关系。

对你来说幸运的是（或不是），一个性感的魅魔已经提议帮助你。这是谁？只是来自地狱的恶魔而已，不用太担心。她很好。恶魔会帮助你与女孩们交朋友，最重要的是，帮助你引诱她们！她为什么需要这个？这么说吧——她以性能量为食，而且她很饿！

一定要遵守合同，不要让她失望。最终落入地狱并不是一个好主意，那里将由她负责。
